name: Minty
source: Young minty haired cat girl and friend of Daring Academy's protagonist and Amelia Sweet. While she is often shown as a sweet and caring girl, Minty loves helping anyone whenever she can. Minty is in a relationship with Delilah and lives with her master, Master Wyllhelm Fernandez.
